app.name: GameExplorer
app.tagline: Your game library on the NAS

help.dropHint: You can also drag files anywhere

errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.conflict: That cannot be done right now.
errors.igdbUnavailable: IGDB is not responding; try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.loadBody: Check the connection to the NAS and try again.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

health.libraryBody: You can browse and download, but not upload or change anything. Check the dataset permissions in TrueNAS (the app's user needs “Modify”).
health.genericBody: Some features may fail until it is fixed.

home.emptyBody: Upload a {{names}} game. Each console shows up here once it has its first game.
home.dropHintConsole: {{name}} comes preselected · you can also drag files
home.unassignedHint: /_unassigned · arrived over Samba or from uploads that did not fit
home.unassignedUpload: No uploads here: pick a file and use “Assign”

search.title: Search
search.prompt: Type a game's name. Case and accents do not matter.
search.noMatchBody: Search ignores case and accents. Try fewer words.

console.emptyBody: Upload an archive or the game's files. {{name}} will come preselected.

game.ownName: A name of your own, not linked to IGDB. You can link it with “Rename”.
game.moveBlocked: No other console takes {{exts}}. “More” has “Move to Unassigned”.
game.unassignBody: It leaves the library and stays in _unassigned/ with its current name. You can assign it again whenever you want.
game.trashBody: You can restore it from Settings › Trash until it is purged.
game.dropHint: Drop an Update or DLC here, or use “Add games”: {{console}} will come preselected
game.goneBody: It was moved to the trash, moved elsewhere or merged with another one.

edit.moveBody: The whole game moves. It can only go to a console that takes all its files.
edit.moreFiles_one: … and {{count}} more file with the new name
edit.moreFiles_other: … and {{count}} more files with the new name
edit.nothing: Type another name to see what will change.
edit.merge: “{{title}}” already exists on that console: the two games will merge. Decide what to do with the files that match.
edit.itemTaken: “{{name}}” already exists in the game. If you replace it, the current one goes to the trash.

igdb.useTextHint: Without IGDB: for mods, translations or games that do not show up
igdb.linked: Linked to IGDB: {{name}} (cover, year and genres)
igdb.ownName: A name of your own, not linked to IGDB
igdb.notConfigured: IGDB is not configured: type the name the way you want it stored. There will be no cover.
igdb.failed: IGDB is not responding. You can go on with the name you typed.

upload.title: Upload game
upload.subtitle: The upload starts when you confirm. Archives are extracted afterwards.
upload.assignSubtitle: The files stay in Unassigned until they are stored. Archives are extracted, then you choose what to store.
upload.badFile: It is not an archive and its extension does not fit {{console}} ({{exts}}). Choose another console or remove the file.

mode.partsHint: game.part1.rar, game.part2.rar… They are extracted together once all are here.
mode.sameHint: For example a base game and its update. One name and one console for all.

upload.stepHint: Confirming moves on to the next
upload.preselected: Preselected from the screen you upload from
upload.name: Game name
upload.afterKinds: Once extracted, we will ask for the kind of each file (base, update or DLC).
upload.afterOne: Once done, we check there is a single {{exts}} file.
upload.submitNext: Upload and go to the next
upload.afterUnassigned: Everything is extracted into Unassigned, next to anything already there with that name. You assign it to a console later.
upload.afterAssign: Once extracted, you choose each file’s type or “Don’t store”.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.needsYou: An upload is waiting for you
uploads.none: No uploads. Drag files or choose some to start.
uploads.wrongFile: That is not the file: expected {{name}} ({{size}}).
uploads.waitingParts: Waiting for the other parts ({{count}} in all)

drop.body: Then you choose the name and the console. Archives are extracted for you and each file goes to its folder.
drop.noFolders: Folders cannot be uploaded: compress them first (zip, 7z or rar).

job.title: Upload
job.goneBody: It may have been cancelled or purged.

state.done: This upload is already in the library
state.trashed: This upload is in the trash
state.busy: This upload is still being processed

details.title: File details
details.ownName: A name of your own, no IGDB
details.intro: Say what each file is. An Update needs its version and a DLC its name; they make up the final name.
details.introOne: We found one valid {{console}} file. Check the final name and store it.
details.existing: You already have “{{title}}” with: {{items}}. The new files are added to that game.
details.pickKind: Choose the kind: base game, update or DLC.
details.needVersion: Type the version: digits and dots only.
details.replace: Replace (the current one goes to the trash)
details.cancelBody: The uploaded and extracted files of “{{name}}” are deleted. This cannot be undone.
details.cancelBodyUnassigned: The files of “{{name}}” stay in Unassigned, as they were.
details.keepSome: Choose at least one file to store.
details.keepOne: {{console}} stores one file per game: leave the others unstored.
details.notGameFiles: Not files of the console; they stay in Unassigned:

invalid.manyTitle: The archive holds more than one game
invalid.none: There is no {{exts}} file, and nothing that fits another console.
invalid.noneOther: There is no {{exts}} file. What it holds fits another console.
invalid.many: {{console}} takes one file per game and this archive holds several. Upload them separately, each with its name.
invalid.whatNow: What do we do with these files?
invalid.changeBody: They move with the same name, without uploading or extracting again.
invalid.fits: {{file}} fits here · will be stored as {{path}}
invalid.unassignedBody: They stay in _unassigned/ to be assigned later.
invalid.trashBody: They can be restored to Unassigned until they are purged.
invalid.deleteBody: Frees the space. Asks for confirmation.
invalid.deleteConfirm: What “{{name}}” brought is deleted without going through the trash, freeing {{size}}. This cannot be undone.
invalid.releaseBody: The files stay in Unassigned, as they were.

unassigned.title: Unassigned
unassigned.intro: What arrived over Samba, uploads without a console or that did not fit, and what you moved here. Each folder of _unassigned/ is one entry, assigned as a whole.
unassigned.deleteBody: “{{name}}” is deleted without going through the trash, freeing {{size}}. This cannot be undone.
unassigned.footnote: “Assign” opens the form with the entry’s name: you choose the console and, when confirming, each file’s type or “Don’t store”. Files you copy over Samba into _unassigned/ show up here right away.
unassigned.emptyBody: Copy files over Samba into _unassigned/, or upload them without a console: they will show up here to be assigned.

scan.title: Library check
scan.body: Changes made over Samba are checked at startup and every so often: what was deleted goes away and what the app does not know goes to Unassigned.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionBody: This device remembers the session until you sign out.
settings.igdbOn: Suggests names as you type and provides covers, years and console logos. Game data from IGDB.com.
settings.igdbHowTo: Everything works the same, but without name suggestions or covers. To turn it on, add IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET to the app and restart it.
settings.legal: The app does not distribute games.

consoles.intro: Consoles are defined in code. Here you change their order and display name, and add extensions of your own.
consoles.name: Display name
consoles.fixedHint: Locked: they come from the console's environment variable and only change there.
consoles.removeBlocked_one: {{ext}} cannot be removed: {{count}} file uses it
consoles.removeBlocked_other: {{ext}} cannot be removed: {{count}} files use it
consoles.cannotRemove_one: {{ext}} cannot be removed: {{count}} file uses it.
consoles.cannotRemove_other: {{ext}} cannot be removed: {{count}} files use it.
consoles.badExtension: Start with a dot and use letters, digits and dots, like .xcz or .nkit.iso.
consoles.extensionTaken: That extension is already in this console.

trash.retention_one: Deleted for good after a day
trash.replaced: Replaced when another copy was uploaded
trash.emptyConfirmBody_one: {{count}} item is deleted for good, freeing {{size}}. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirmBody_other: {{count}} items are deleted for good, freeing {{size}}. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyBody: What you send here can be restored until it is purged.
trash.conflictBody: After you trashed it you stored another copy. If you restore “{{title}}”, the current one goes to the trash.
